# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_MEANREV_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extended deviation of price above the EMA ribbon (EMA20) signals imminent mean reversion to the ribbon during low-volatility choppy periods. This edge exists because intraday trends often pause between 11:00-14:00 EST, allowing mean-reversion forces to dominate when price is stretched beyond the ribbon with bearish momentum confirmation (RSI>70 and bearish candle).

## Mechanism

Entry: When price > upper ribbon (EMA20) by ≥1.0×ATR(14) AND RSI(14) > 70 AND the bar's close < open (bearish candle), enter short at the bar's close.  
Exit: Stop at upper ribbon + 0.5×ATR; target at lower ribbon (EMA20) or at 1R; optionally exit if price re-enters the ribbon.  
Regime filter: Only active when VIX between 12-18 and time between 11:00-14:00 EST.
